# Mitishell v1.3.2

Tons of bug fixes for the new launcher and actions menu

## Fixes

- Screenshot Output now lists every connected output in the Actions menu, so a screenshot can target a specific monitor instead of the focused one.
- Launcher actions no longer stop responding after a capture.
- Notifications now expire even when their popup cannot show (e.g. during DND).
- `mitishell record region` show the Actions menu with its stop action while a recording is active instead of an empty list.
- Launcher-triggered captures start only after the launcher finishes closing, so the region selector never appears underneath it.
- Fixed a binding loop warning in the launcher result rows.
- Reinstalling Mitishell no longer leaves a partial installation if it is interrupted.

## Install

Download the archive matching your system and `SHA256SUMS` from this release. Then run:

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
tar -xzf mitishell-v1.3.2-linux-amd64.tar.gz    # or mitishell-v1.3.2-linux-arm64.tar.gz
cd mitishell-v1.3.2-linux-amd64
make install-prebuilt
quickshell -n -p ~/.local/share/mitishell/shell
```
